title: Biochemical oxygen demand versus incubation time
license: Factual data from a 1967 thesis, reproduced in Bates & Watts (1988) and in R 'datasets'; verify reuse terms for publication.
description: Oxygen demand of a water sample after incubation for 1 to 7 days (no measurement on day 6).

conditions.note: As reported by the source; incubation temperature not given in the reproduced table.

uncertainty.note: No stated uncertainty and no replicates.

applicability: First-order BOD curve fitting exercises; six points only, so parameter uncertainty is large.

k.note: published as log(k) = -0.6328 (SE 0.3825); k and its standard error derived here (k = e^-0.6328, SE = k·0.3825)

published_analyses.note: Same estimates as Bates & Watts (1988); values from the nls() example on the BOD data.
